en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Ahmad bin Idrees, from Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Isa bin Muhammed, from Ali bin Mahziyar, from Ahmad bin Muhammed al-Bazanti, from Yahya bin Imran, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And We granted to him Ishaq, and Ya’qoub as an addition.» [21:72] He said: A child of the child is an addition.
